items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: A status badge with an animated ping indicator and five colour variants for system states, user presence and service health.

items.name: direction-provider
items.title: Direction Provider
items.description: Provides bidirectional text support (RTL/LTR) across your application, with a reader that falls back to the nearest DOM dir attribute when no provider is present.

items.name: pending
items.title: Pending
items.description: A utility that disables interactions, keeps keyboard focus and wires the correct ARIA state for buttons, forms, links, switches and any interactive element while it is pending.
